title: All About Christmas Eve
description: Evelyn's future depends on whether she makes a flight to Los Angeles. She lives out both futures in parallel: In one she plans a huge Christmas event, and in the other she becomes an artist.

title: A Snow Globe Christmas
description: After a blow to the head, a cynical TV executive (Alicia Witt) wakes up in a seemingly perfect town, married to her former sweetheart (Donald Faison) and raising two children.

title: Dear Christmas
description: A podcast host develops an unexpected romance with a local firefighter during the holidays.

title: Mistletoe in Montana
description: An unlucky-in-love ranch owner feels an undeniable connection to a single father with two children who has booked her ranch for the week of Christmas.

description: Rival toy shop owners reluctantly join forces when an unscrupulous toy magnate opens a box store in their town.

title: A Very Nutty Christmas
